notes: Fitment lists come mostly from KTM Direct (ktmdirect.co.uk, UK KTM dealer) product pages, which print a per-part model/year compatibility list, and from AOMC (aomc.mx, US KTM/Husqvarna/GasGas dealer) product titles. No official KTM/Husqvarna/GasGas web page with part number + fitment was found, so nothing is rated 'high'. Dealer fitment lists stop at MY2026 (2027 not yet populated); AOMC titles often say '23-27'. Enduro models (EXC, XC-W, TE, FE, EC, SMR) are removed from fits even where the source lists them.

platforms.description: KTM-group 4-stroke MX/XC chassis introduced MY2023 (new frame, engine, bodywork). The SX-F Factory Editions released in 2022 as early MY23 bikes are catalogued by dealers as 'Factory Edition 2022'. Carried through 2026; KTM's 2027 350 SX-F page describes 'revised frame updates' (shock-mount area, engine mounts, front-frame wall thickness) without a new generation.
platforms.models_years: KTM 250/350/450 SX-F 2023-2027 (Factory Edition from 2022), 250/350/450 XC-F 2023+; Husqvarna FC 250/350/450 and FX 350/450 2023+; GasGas MC 250F/350F/450F and EX 2024+ (see gg-2024)

platforms.description: KTM-group 2-stroke MX/XC chassis (2023+ frame shared with 4T; throttle-body injection 2-strokes). Dealer fitment lists put 125 SX, 300 SX, 125/250/300 XC on this platform from 2023; 250 SX appears from 2024 on some parts (triple clamp, expansion chamber). Treat the 250 SX 2023 as needing a per-part check.
Husqvarna TC/FC/TX/FX on the shared 2023+ platform. AOMC labels shared parts 'SX/TC/Enduro 23-27' or 'SX-F/XC-F/FX 23-27'.

GasGas MC range moved to the shared KTM/Husqvarna platform for MY2024: all-new frame, new forged triple clamps, new engines, WP XACT suspension, new bodywork, Neken bar. The map select switch is fitted on the MC 125, optional on the MC 250 2-stroke, and an add-on for the 4-strokes; on the 4-strokes it enables launch control, traction control and quickshift.
platforms.models_years: GasGas MC 125, MC 250, MC 250F, MC 350F, MC 450F 2024+ (EX cross-country models assumed to follow; not verified)

products.what_it_changes: Bluetooth unit (between the fork and triple clamp, behind the number plate) plus a GPS receiver on the fender, paired with the free KTMconnect app. It adds engine settings (PRIME/ADVANCED modes, engine braking, throttle response, TC, launch control, quickshifter, track presets), a sag assistant and suspension recommendations. Rider Coach adds lap data (manufacturer/dealer claim).
products.supporting_parts: MY22 and MY23 4-strokes need a dealer EFI mapping update; MY24 4T needs none (KTM Direct). The KTMconnect app is required. The replacement fender is included.
products.caveats: Rider Coach needs a subscription after a 1-month trial (GBP 59.99/yr, KTM Direct). The dealer list stops at MY2025 SX-F and MY2024 XC-F, so check 2026+ with a dealer.

gaps: No official KTM/Husqvarna/GasGas web page or PDF catalogue giving part number + fitment was found (ktm.com PowerParts pages are navigation only; the online configurator was not accessible), so nothing is rated 'high'.

Map Select Switch: standard on KTM/Husqvarna SX-F/FC; on 2024 GasGas the 4-strokes need it added to get launch control, TC and quickshift (bikesales). The GasGas/2-stroke map switch part numbers were not found.

Husqvarna Technical Accessories: no Husqvarna-specific part numbers (blue Factory wheels, blue triple clamps, Husqvarna CUO kit) captured; Iron City Motorcycles Husqvarna pages redirect to ironoffroad.co.uk, which was blocked (permission not answered): https://ironoffroad.co.uk/?path=husqvarna%2Fhusqvarna-store%2Fdetail%2Ffactory-racing-triple-clamp%2Fhus-a46001999021c1a and ...hus-2620199902168 (2620199902168 = older Husqvarna Factory Racing triple clamp).
GasGas: only the triple clamp (A46001999021FAA) and wheels (A46009901044FA / A46010901044FA) captured; GasGas CUO, Hinson cover, start device variants not found.
KTM 85 SX: no PowerParts records gathered (KTM Direct 85 SX 2025 collections exist: https://ktmdirect.co.uk/collections/ktm-85-sx-19-16-2025-powerparts-accessories/65-sx?page=2).
MY2027 fitment: dealer lists stop at 2026; AOMC titles say 23-27 but are title-level.
Two Factory Start Device numbers (A54001996000FAA / A54001996500FAA) with identical dealer fitment; relationship unknown.
Hinson full clutch kits, Factory ignition cover, footpegs, seat options, handlebars, chains and brake parts (Factory caliper etc.) not individually recorded.
Prior generation (2019-2022) covered only by one Akrapovič Racing Line record; 2020-2022 Factory triple clamps, skid plates and wheels not mapped.
Direct ktmdirect collection-filter URLs (e.g. /collections/powerparts/450-sx-f+engine-parts) were blocked by URL provenance rules; only URLs surfaced by search could be fetched.
